ByteTrack Integration
=====================

Third-party ByteTrack object tracking library integrated for persistent object IDs.

.. note::
   ByteTrack is a third-party library. Only the main tracker module is documented here.
   For full ByteTrack documentation, see the `official repository <https://github.com/ifzhang/ByteTrack>`_.
